usageNotes: Use this to modify an existing cluster-level vzdump backup job — changing its schedule, target storage, compression, retention policy, or guest scope. Requires 'Sys.Modify' on '/'; the 'tmpdir', 'dumpdir', and 'script' parameters are additionally restricted to root@pam. Returns null synchronously — the updated job takes effect on the next scheduler run, not immediately. To remove individual settings (e.g. strip a node pin), pass their names in the 'delete' field rather than omitting them.

examples.summary: Change a nightly backup job to use zstd compression, target PBS storage, and keep the last 7 daily backups

params.comment: Nightly full cluster backup — zstd, 7-day retention

tips: Use the 'delete' param to unset fields (e.g. 'delete': 'node') rather than sending an empty string — omitting a field leaves the existing value unchanged.
Prefer 'schedule' (systemd calendar format) over the deprecated 'starttime'/'dow' combo; Proxmox converts old-style entries automatically but new jobs should use the modern format.
Setting 'repeat-missed': true is useful for clusters where the node may be offline during the scheduled window — the job will fire as soon as the scheduler comes back up.
Backup fleecing ('fleecing' param) can significantly reduce guest downtime during VM backups by staging changed blocks to a scratch storage; requires a fast local storage ID.
To temporarily pause a job without deleting it, set 'enabled': false instead of removing the job.
